nonoverlapping_interior_groups.basis: P-533 bedroom and bathroom inside same suite

global_accounting.gross_area_definition: projected area of occupied block envelope, not sum of partitions nor false solid disk
global_accounting.level_local_galleries: additional usable floor within same vertical block, not additional global storeys
global_accounting.voids: vertical core void subtract from usable floor where cut, not from all envelope projections
global_accounting.no_auto_sum_of_groups: groups represent containers and overlap child rooms; sum only explicitly disjoint interiors

assumed_disjoint_level_budgets.purpose: Prevent industrial envelope and distinct small-craft docks exceeding Lower footprint and structural volume
Prevent ring, plaza and farther play fields exceeding Children projected area; do not double count interior cabins
Upper cruiser complex and productive hall must fit Upper block without double counting their internal rooms

level_area_budget_interpretation: Selected listed major compartments are treated as independent allocation zones solely for this explicit hypothesis. Disable/edit groups when book identity or overlap is uncertain. Never blindly sum every concept or child room.

M-L2-RES-001.reason: Two locally distinct residential/storey layers; precise continuity of upper floor unknown

M-L1-CH-001.reason: Upper internal bridge is a partial mezzanine

MOAG-G-0036.reason: Upper gallery around round rest hall is partial not a new global floor

usable_floor_accounting.default_note: single local floor equivalent in working model, editable if evidence of internal storey appears
usable_floor_accounting.negative_constraint: A high clear volume cannot be counted as multiple full floors just because its ceiling is tall
